label: Excavated
value: By the Italian Archaeological Mission, 1963 to 1982, with a pause from 1966 to 1977
quote: The excavations were initiated by the Italian Archaeological Mission in 1963 and ended in 1982, with a pause between 1966 and 1977.

label: Where
value: Near Saidu Sharif, at the foot of the hills in Swat District
quote: located near the city of Saidu Sharif, at the foot of the mountains that separate the river valley Saidu from that of the river Jambil, in the Swat District of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan

label: What to see
value: A main stupa with smaller monuments and a monastery above
quote: Artificial terracing includes one stūpa, surrounded by smaller monuments, and a monastery.

label: Terraces
value: Two terraces cut into the hillside
quote: The sacred area consists of two terraces built on the slope of the hill, through a cut in the rock on the north side.

label: Main stupa stair
value: On the north side of the main stupa
quote: with a stairway on the north side

label: History
value: First building period from 25 BCE to the end of the 1st century
quote: between 25 BCE and the end of the 1st century
